Orbis Robotics
OR-6
Load, unload and deburr robot cell
Cell Maintenance Guide
Revision 3
For qualified maintenance personnel


1 Safety
1.1 General safety
Only qualified maintenance personnel who are trained on the OR-6 may enter the cell. Never bypass the light curtain
or a door interlock, and stay clear of the arm: it can move without warning while the cell has power. If anything moves
unexpectedly, press the emergency stop and leave the cell by the safety door.
1.2 Lockout and tagout
Move the robot to the service position, switch off the cell isolator and fit your personal lock and tag. The drive
capacitors keep a dangerous charge after power off, so wait 5 minutes for the drive capacitors to discharge before
you touch a drive. Release the compressed air from the gripper valve block and verify zero energy before you start.
Orbis Robotics OR-6 Cell Maintenance Guide, Revision 3
Page 2

The control shows these codes. Likely causes are listed in order of likelihood.
Code
Message
Severity
Likely causes
Action

Gripper part-present signal lost
warning
worn gripper fingers (most likely)
See 4.1 Replace gripper fingers
(plant ref PROC-RW-01)
RB-560
Axis 2 overcurrent
critical

See 4.2 Inspect axis 2 and reset servo drive
(plant ref PROC-RW-02)
RB-563

See 4.2 Inspect axis 2 and reset servo drive

See 4.3 Realign light curtain

3 Troubleshooting table
Find the symptom, then follow the remedy.
Symptom
Probable cause
Remedy
robot dropping parts at the deburr station
worn gripper fingers
See 4.1 Replace gripper fingers
(plant ref PROC-RW-01)
axis 2 trips on overcurrent during fast moves
axis 2 overload from binding or a failing drive
See 4.2 Inspect axis 2 and reset servo drive
(plant ref PROC-RW-02)
cell stops randomly, light curtain fault
misaligned light curtain
See 4.3 Realign light curtain
(plant ref PROC-RW-03)
Orbis Robotics OR-6 Cell Maintenance Guide, Revision 3
Page 4


4 Procedures
4.1 Replace gripper fingers
Plant ref: PROC-RW-01 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 40 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Move the robot to the service position and apply lockout and tagout on the cell isolator.
 2. Release air from the gripper valve block.
 3. Unbolt the worn fingers and fit two GRP-FNG-12 fingers.
 4. Remove the lockout and teach the part-present sensor on a master part.
 
Order no.
Description
Qty
GRP-FNG-12
Gripper finger, hardened
2
4.2 Inspect axis 2 and reset servo drive
Plant ref: PROC-RW-02 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 90 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Apply lockout and tagout on the cell isolator and wait 5 minutes for the drive capacitors to discharge.
 2. Check the axis 2 gearbox for binding by moving the arm by hand.
 3. Replace the drive fuse with FUSE-SRV-10, and replace the idler bearing with BRG-6205-2RS if it feels rough.
 4. Remove the lockout, reset the drive and run axis 2 at 10 percent speed.
 
Order no.
Description
Qty
FUSE-SRV-10
Servo drive fuse 10 A
1
BRG-6205-2RS
Deep groove ball bearing 6205-2RS
1
4.3 Realign light curtain
Plant ref: PROC-RW-03 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 30 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Apply lockout and tagout on the cell isolator.
 2. Check both light curtain brackets and replace a bent one with BRKT-LC-01.
 3. Align the emitter and receiver until all beam LEDs are green.
 4. Remove the lockout and run the muting test from the safety menu.
 
Order no.
Description
Qty
BRKT-LC-01
Light curtain mounting bracket
1
Orbis Robotics OR-6 Cell Maintenance Guide, Revision 3
